project_description: Replace Go-LIP stream-time billing/accounting with a CDR-first architecture: compute a conservative maximum customer charge after route planning, atomically reserve that amount against prepaid balance/credit before any upstream work, execute the LLM turn without billing logic, seal one immutable Turn CDR with final attempt evidence, then post-process the CDR to rate actual customer charge/operator cost, settle/release the reservation, and drive reporting. Concurrent turns share one balance safely through atomic outstanding pessimistic holds. Delete runtime usage reconciliation, per-event pricing, economic dedupe/accumulators, and raw-fact settlement paths.
